Maya: Heads-up — AP found that vendor price_sheet_v2.csv includes a new column `reserved_discount` we didn't account for. This touches cohort B pricing for the A/B rollout tomorrow. Anyone have context? :eyes:

```
plan,base,reserved_discount
standard,0.10,0.02
dedicated,0.08,0.03
```
Eleanor: That's unexpected. Procurement — did we sign off on a price model change?
Tom: Procurement says they saw an informal note but no formal amendment. BillingBot: Automated alert — price sheet change detected for NV-92 at 2026-03-23T09:12:05Z (diff present).

James: Can we pause the A/B rollout scheduled for tomorrow? I don't want to ship pricing with this ambiguity.
Sarah: I can pause canary now and freeze the mapping. Eng-billing / eng-runtime: please confirm we can lock price ingestion.

1) Pause rollout (Sarah)
2) Lock price-sheet ingestion + rollback last ingest (eng-billing)
3) Contact vendor to confirm whether change was intentional
4) Run dry-run invoices for Mar 20–23 window for cohorts A/B
5) Decide credits/grandfathering if customers were affected

James: I'll draft the customer note. @Ella (support) — please standby for potential ticket surge.
